11:1: The letters of the alphabet have been discussed at the beginning of Surat Al-Baqarah, so there is no need to repeat them here. And God is the Grantor of success. As for His statement: His verses are perfected and then detailed, meaning they are perfect in their wording and detailed in their meaning, so it is complete in form and meaning. This is the meaning of what was narrated on the authority of Mujahid and Qatadah, and Ibn Jarir chose it. The meaning of His statement, From the side of One Who is Wise and All-Aware, is from God, the Wise in His words and rulings, All-Aware of the consequences of matters. That you worship none but God, meaning this perfect and detailed Qur’an was revealed for the worship of God alone, with no partner for Him, as God the Most High said: And We did not send before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that there is no god but Me, so worship Me, and He said: And We have certainly sent to every nation a messenger, [saying], ‘Worship God and avoid false deities,’ and His statement, Indeed, I am to you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings, meaning that I am to you a warner of the punishment if you disobey Him, and a bringer of good tidings of the reward if you obey Him, as came in the authentic hadith that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: He ascended Safa and called the nearest clans of Quraysh, then the nearest, and they gathered together and said: O people of Quraysh, what do you think if I told you that horses would attack you in the morning, would you not believe me? They said: We have never experienced you lying. He said: Then I am a warner to you before a severe punishment. And His statement: “And that you seek forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will grant you good provision for a specified term and will give every possessor of virtue his favour.” That is, I command you to seek forgiveness for past sins and repent from them to God Almighty in what you will face, and to continue in that. He will grant you good provision meaning in this world. For a specified term and will give every possessor of virtue his favour meaning in the Hereafter. Qatada said it like His statement: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life (al-Baqarah 2:17). It was reported in Sahih that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said to Sa`d, You will not spend anything seeking thereby the face of God except that you will be rewarded for it, even what you put in your wife’s mouth. Ibn Jarir said: Al-Musayyab bin Sharik told me on the authority of Abu Bakr on the authority of Sa`id bin Jubayr on the authority of Ibn Mas`ud, may God be pleased with him, regarding His statement, And every possessor of virtue will be given his virtue, he said, “Whoever does a bad deed will have a bad deed recorded against him, and whoever does a good deed will have ten good deeds recorded for him. If he is punished for the bad deed he did in this world, ten good deeds will remain for him, and if he is not punished for it in this world, one of the ten good deeds will be taken away and nine good deeds will remain for him. Then he says, ‘He who has one deed more than ten deed is doomed.’” And His statement, But if you turn away, then indeed I fear for you the punishment of a great Day, is a severe threat to whoever turns away from the commands of God Almighty and rejects His Messengers, for the punishment will inevitably befall him on the Day of Resurrection. To God is your return, meaning your return on the Day of Resurrection, and He is over all things competent, meaning He is capable of whatever He wills of His kindness to His friends, His vengeance on His enemies, and the restoration of creation. The Day of Resurrection, and this is a position of intimidation, just as the first is a position of encouragement.

11:5: Ibn Abbas said: They hated to face the sky with their private parts and during intercourse, so God revealed this verse. Al-Bukhari narrated it on the authority of Ibn Jurayj on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abbad ibn Ja'far that Ibn Abbas recited: Behold, they turn their chests aside, the verse. I said: O Abu al-Abbas, what is it that they turn their chests aside? He said: A man would have intercourse with his wife and feel shy, or relieve himself and feel shy, so this verse was revealed: Behold, they turn their chests aside. In another version of his, Ibn Abbas said: Some people were shy to relieve themselves and go to the sky, or to have intercourse with their wives and go to the sky, so this verse was revealed about them. Then he said: Al-Hamidi told us, Sufyan told us, Amr told us, Ibn Abbas recited: Behold, they turn their chests aside to hide from Him, except when they cover themselves with their garments. Al-Bukhari said, and others said on the authority of Ibn Abbas, They cover themselves means covering their heads. Ibn Abbas said in another narration in the interpretation of this verse: He means doubting God and doing evil deeds. And this was also narrated on the authority of Mujahid, Al-Hasan, and others, meaning that they would cover their chests when they said or did something, thinking that they were hiding it from God. So God Almighty informed them that when they covered themselves with their clothes when they slept in the darkness of the night, He knows what they conceal of speech, “and what they declare. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts” meaning He knows what their breasts conceal of intentions, consciences, and secrets. How beautiful is what Zuhair ibn Abi Salma said in his famous Mu’allaqat: So do not conceal from God what is in your hearts, lest it be hidden. Whatever is concealed, God knows. It is either delayed and placed in a book and stored for the Day of Reckoning, or it is hastened and punished. This pre-Islamic poet acknowledged the existence of the Creator and His knowledge of details, resurrection, reward, and the writing of deeds in the books on the Day of Resurrection. Abdullah bin Shaddad said: When one of them passed by the Messenger of God, he would turn his chest away from him and cover his head, so God revealed that. The return of the pronoun to God is more appropriate, because of His saying: Unquestionably, when they cover themselves with their garments, He knows what they conceal and what they declare. Ibn Abbas read: Unquestionably, they turn their chests away, raising the chests as the subject, and this is close in meaning.
11:6: God Almighty informed us that He is responsible for the sustenance of all creatures on earth, large and small, on land and at sea, and that He knows their resting place and their place of storage, meaning He knows where they end their journey on earth and where they take refuge in their den, which is their place of storage. Ali bin Abi Talha and others said on the authority of Ibn Abbas, And He knows their resting place, meaning where they take refuge, and their place of storage, where they die. And on the authority of Mujahid, their place of storage is in the womb, and their place of storage in the loins, like that of livestock. This was also narrated on the authority of Ibn Abbas, Ad-Dahhak, and a group. Ibn Abi Hatim mentioned the statements of the commentators here as he mentioned regarding that verse, so God knows best. And that all of that is written in a book with God that explains all of that, like His saying: “There is no creature on earth or bird that flies with its wings except that they are communities like you. We have not neglected anything in the Book. Then to their Lord they will be gathered.” And His saying: “And with Him are the keys of the unseen. None knows them except Him. And He knows what is on the land and the sea. Not a leaf falls but that He knows it. And no grain is there within the darknesses of the earth and no moist or dry thing but that it is [all] in a clear Book.”
11:7: God the Almighty tells us about His power over everything and that He created the heavens and the earth in six days and that His throne was on the water before that as Imam Ahmad said: Abu Muawiyah told us, Al-A'mash told us, on the authority of Jami' bin Shaddad, on the authority of Safwan bin Mahraz, on the authority of Imran bin Husayn, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Accept the good report, O Banu Tamim. They said: You have given us good report, so give us. He said: Accept the good report, O people of Yemen. They said: We have accepted. So tell us about the beginning of this matter, how it was? He said: God was before everything, and His throne was on the water, and He wrote in the Preserved Tablet the mention of everything. He said: Then someone came to me and said: O Imran, your she-camel has been untied from its tether. He said: So I went out after it and I do not know what came after me. This hadith is reported in the two Sahihs of Al-Bukhari and Muslim with many wordings, including: They said: We came to you to ask you about the beginning of this matter, so he said: God was and there was nothing before Him. In another narration - other than him - and in another narration With him - and his throne was over the water, and he wrote everything in the remembrance, then he created the heavens and the earth. In Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Abdullah bin Amr bin Al-Aas, he said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: God determined the destinies of creation fifty thousand years before He created the heavens and the earth, and His Throne was over the water. Al-Bukhari said in his interpretation of this verse: Abu Al-Yaman told us, Shu’ayb told us, Abu Al-Zinad told us, on the authority of Al-A’raj, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “God Almighty said: Spend, and I will spend on you.” And he said: “The hand of God is full, and no spending decreases it. He is generous by night and by day.” And he said: “Have you seen what He has spent since He created the heavens and the earth? What is in His right hand has not decreased, and His Throne was over the water, and in His hand is the scale; He lowers and raises.” Imam Ahmad said: Yazid bin Harun told us, Hammad bin Salamah told us, on the authority of Ya`la bin Ata`, on the authority of Wakee` bin Adas, on the authority of his uncle Abu Razeen, whose name was Laqeet bin Aamer bin Al-Muntafiq Al-`Aqili, who said: I said: O Messenger of God, where was our Lord before He created His creation? He said: He was in a cloud with no air beneath it and no air above it, then He created the Throne after that. Al-Tirmidhi narrated it in his Tafseer and Ibn Majah in his Sunan from the hadith of Yazid bin Harun with it. Al-Tirmidhi said: This is a good hadith. Mujahid said: And His Throne was over the water before He created anything. Wahb bin Munabbih, Damrah, Qatadah, Ibn Jarir and others said the same. Qatadah said regarding His statement: And His Throne was over the water He is informing you of how the beginning of His creation was before He created the heavens and the earth. Al-Rabi` bin Anas said: And His Throne was over the water so when He created the heavens and the earth He divided that water into two parts and made one half under the Throne, which is the burning sea. Ibn Abbas said: The throne was called the throne because of its height. Ismail bin Abi Khalid said: I heard Saad al-Ta’i say: The throne is a red ruby. Muhammad bin Ishaq said regarding the words of God Almighty: And it is He who created the heavens and the earth in six days, and His throne was over the water, so it was as He described Himself, the Almighty, since there is nothing but water, and upon Him is the throne, and upon the throne is the possessor of majesty and honor, and might and authority, and dominion and power, and forbearance and knowledge, and mercy and grace, the doer of what He wills. Al-A’mash said on the authority of al-Munhal bin Amr on the authority of Saeed bin Jubayr, who said: Ibn Abbas was asked about the words of God Almighty: And His throne was over the water, on what was the water? He said on the wind, and the Almighty’s saying: To test you as to which of you is best in deed means He created the heavens and the earth to benefit His servants whom He created to worship Him and not associate anything with Him, and He did not create that in vain, as He said: “And We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.” And the Almighty said: “Did you think that We created you in vain and that to Us you would not be returned? * So exalted is God, the True King. There is no god but He, Lord of the Noble Throne.” And the Almighty said: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me the verse, and His saying To test you means to test you as to which of you is best in deed. He did not say more work, but rather the best work, and the work is not good until it is sincere to God the Almighty according to the law of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, so when the work lacks one of these two conditions, it is nullified and invalidated. And His saying: And if you say, ‘You will be resurrected after death’ the verse means that God Almighty says: And if you, O Muhammad, were to inform these polytheists that God will resurrect them after their death as He began them, even though they know that God Almighty is the One Who created the heavens and the earth, as God Almighty says: And if you were to ask them, ‘Who created them?’ they would surely say, ‘God.’ “And if you were to ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?’ they would surely say, ‘God.’” And despite this, they deny resurrection and revival on the Day of Resurrection, which is easier for the Almighty than the beginning, as God Almighty says: And it is He who begins creation and then repeats it, and that is easier for Him. And God Almighty says: He did not create you and resurrect you except as a single soul. And their saying: This is nothing but obvious magic, meaning they say out of disbelief and stubbornness, We do not believe you about the occurrence of resurrection, and no one mentions that except his magicians, so he follows you in what you say. And His saying: And if We postpone the punishment from them for a limited term, the verse. God Almighty says: “And if We delay the punishment and the punishment for these polytheists for a specified term and a limited period and We threaten them for a specified period, they will surely say in denial and hastening, ‘What is holding it back?’” That is, what is delaying this punishment from Us? Their nature has become accustomed to denial and doubt, so there remains for them no escape from it or way to avoid it. The word nation is used in the Qur’an and Sunnah in various meanings, meaning a period, as in His statement in this verse: for a specified nation. And His saying about Joseph: And the one of them who was saved said, and remembered after a time. It is used for the leader who is followed, as in His saying: Indeed, Abraham was a nation obedient to God, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists. It is used for religion and faith, as in His saying, informing about the polytheists, that they said: Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and indeed, we are following in their footsteps. It is used for the group, as in His saying: And when he came to the water of Madyan, he found there a nation of people watering their [own] water. And His saying: And We had certainly sent to every nation a messenger, [saying], ‘Worship God and avoid false gods.’ And God Almighty said: “And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, the matter will be judged between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.” What is meant by the nation here are those among whom the messenger is sent, their believers and their disbelievers, as in Sahih Muslim: By Him in Whose Hand is my soul, no one from this nation, Jew or Christian, hears of me and then does not believe in me, except that he will enter the Fire. As for the nation of followers, they are those who believe in the messengers, as God Almighty said: You are the best nation produced for mankind. In Sahih, I say, ‘My nation, my nation.’ The word nation is used to mean a group or a sect, as in the Almighty’s saying: And among the people of Moses was a nation guiding with the truth and doing justice thereby. And as in His saying: Among the People of the Scripture was a community standing.

Al-A’mash said on the authority of al-Munhal bin Amr on the authority of Saeed bin Jubayr, who said: Ibn Abbas was asked about the words of God Almighty: And His throne was over the water, on what was the water? He said on the wind, and the Almighty’s saying: To test you as to which of you is best in deed means He created the heavens and the earth to benefit His servants whom He created to worship Him and not associate anything with Him, and He did not create that in vain, as He said: “And We did not create the heaven and the earth and what is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.” And the Almighty said: “Did you think that We created you in vain and that to Us you would not be returned? * So exalted is God, the True King. There is no god but He, Lord of the Noble Throne.” And the Almighty said: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me the verse, and His saying To test you means to test you as to which of you is best in deed. He did not say more work, but rather the best work, and the work is not good until it is sincere to God the Almighty according to the law of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, so when the work lacks one of these two conditions, it is nullified and invalidated. And His saying: And if you say, ‘You will be resurrected after death’ the verse means that God Almighty says: And if you, O Muhammad, were to inform these polytheists that God will resurrect them after their death as He began them, even though they know that God Almighty is the One Who created the heavens and the earth, as God Almighty says: And if you were to ask them, ‘Who created them?’ they would surely say, ‘God.’ “And if you were to ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and the earth and subjected the sun and the moon?’ they would surely say, ‘God.’” And despite this, they deny resurrection and revival on the Day of Resurrection, which is easier for the Almighty than the beginning, as God Almighty says: And it is He who begins creation and then repeats it, and that is easier for Him. And God Almighty says: He did not create you and resurrect you except as a single soul. And their saying: This is nothing but obvious magic, meaning they say out of disbelief and stubbornness, We do not believe you about the occurrence of resurrection, and no one mentions that except his magicians, so he follows you in what you say. And His saying: And if We postpone the punishment from them for a limited term, the verse. God Almighty says: “And if We delay the punishment and the punishment for these polytheists for a specified term and a limited period and We threaten them for a specified period, they will surely say in denial and hastening, ‘What is holding it back?’” That is, what is delaying this punishment from Us? Their nature has become accustomed to denial and doubt, so there remains for them no escape from it or way to avoid it. The word nation is used in the Qur’an and Sunnah in various meanings, meaning a period, as in His statement in this verse: for a specified nation. And His saying about Joseph: And the one of them who was saved said, and remembered after a time. It is used for the leader who is followed, as in His saying: Indeed, Abraham was a nation obedient to God, inclining toward truth, and he was not of the polytheists. It is used for religion and faith, as in His saying, informing about the polytheists, that they said: Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and indeed, we are following in their footsteps. It is used for the group, as in His saying: And when he came to the water of Madyan, he found there a nation of people watering their [own] water. And His saying: And We had certainly sent to every nation a messenger, [saying], ‘Worship God and avoid false gods.’ And God Almighty said: “And for every nation is a messenger. So when their messenger comes, the matter will be judged between them with justice, and they will not be wronged.” What is meant by the nation here are those among whom the messenger is sent, their believers and their disbelievers, as in Sahih Muslim: By Him in Whose Hand is my soul, no one from this nation, Jew or Christian, hears of me and then does not believe in me, except that he will enter the Fire. As for the nation of followers, they are those who believe in the messengers, as God Almighty said: You are the best nation produced for mankind. In Sahih, I say, ‘My nation, my nation.’ The word nation is used to mean a group or a sect, as in the Almighty’s saying: And among the people of Moses was a nation guiding with the truth and doing justice thereby. And as in His saying: Among the People of the Scripture was a community standing.
11:9: God Almighty tells us about man and the reprehensible qualities within him, except for those of his believing servants whom God has mercy upon. If he is afflicted with hardship after a blessing, he becomes hopeless and despairs of goodness in the future, and becomes disbelief and denial of the past, as if he had not seen goodness and had not hoped for relief after that. And thus if a blessing befalls him after a calamity, he will surely say, ‘The evil deeds have gone from me’ meaning he will say: No injustice or harm will befall me after this. “Indeed, he is joyful and boastful,” meaning he is happy with what he has in his hand, proudly arrogant towards others. God the Most High said: Except for those who are patient, meaning in hardships and misfortunes, and do righteous deeds, meaning in ease and well-being. For them is forgiveness, meaning for what befalls them of hardship, and a great reward, for what they did in times of ease, as stated in the hadith: “By the One in Whose hand is my soul, no worry, grief, fatigue, illness, or sadness befalls a believer, not even the prick he receives from a thorn, except that God expiates some of his sins because of it.” And in the two Sahihs: “By the One in Whose hand is my soul, God does not decree for a believer a decision except that it is good for him. If ease befalls him and he is grateful, it is good for him, and if hardship befalls him and he is patient, it is good for him. And that is not the case for anyone except the believer.” For this reason God the Most High said: By time, indeed, mankind is in loss, except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience. And God the Most High said: Indeed, man was created anxious.

11:12: The Almighty says, comforting His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, about what the polytheists were stubborn about in what they were saying about the Messenger, as the Almighty informed about them in His statement: “And they said, ‘What is this Messenger that he eats food and walks in the markets? Why is not an angel sent down to him to be a warner with him? Or is a treasure thrown down to him or is there for him a garden from which he can eat?’ And the wrongdoers say, ‘You are following none but a man bewitched.’” So God Almighty commanded His Messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, and guided him not to be distressed by that, nor to be turned away or prevented from calling them to God Almighty at all times of the night and day, as the Almighty said: And We certainly know that your breast is constrained by what they say, the verse, and He said here, Perhaps you would abandon some of what is revealed to you, and your breast is constrained by it because they say, meaning because of their saying that, you are only a warner, and you have an example in your brothers from the messengers before you, for they were denied and harmed, but they were patient until the victory of God Almighty came to them. Then the Almighty explained The miracle of the Qur’an and that no one can produce anything like it, nor ten surahs like it, nor a surah like it, because the speech of the Lord Almighty is not like the speech of created beings, just as His attributes are not like the attributes of created things. Nothing resembles His Essence, He is exalted, sanctified and transcendent. There is no god but Him, and there is no lord but Him. Then the Almighty said: So if they do not respond to you, if they do not produce anything that opposes what you have called them to, then know that they are incapable of that and that this speech was sent down from God and includes His knowledge, His commands and His prohibitions, and that there is no god but Him, so will you submit?

11:15: Al-Awfi said on the authority of Ibn Abbas regarding this verse: The people of hypocrisy are rewarded for their good deeds in this world, and that is because they will not be wronged even by a speck. He says: Whoever does a good deed seeking this world, fasting, praying, or praying at night, and does not do it except seeking this world, God the Most High says: He will give him what he sought in this world of reward, and his work which he did for seeking this world will be in vain, and he will be among the losers in the Hereafter. And thus it was narrated on the authority of Mujahid, Ad-Dahhak, and others. Anas bin Malik and Al-Hasan said: It was revealed about the Jews and Christians. Mujahid and others said: It was revealed about the people of hypocrisy. Qatada said: Whoever has the world as his concern, intention, and pursuit, God will reward him for his good deeds in this world, then he will go to the Hereafter and he will not have a good deed for which he will be given a reward. As for the believer, he will be rewarded for his good deeds in this world and will be rewarded for them in the Hereafter. Something similar to this has been reported in the hadith attributed to the Prophet. God the Most High said: “Whoever desires the immediate, We hasten for him therein what We will for whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell.” He will enter it blamed and rejected. And whoever desires the Hereafter and strives for it with the necessary effort while he is a believer - for those, their effort is ever appreciated. No, these and those We provide from the gift of your Lord, and the gift of your Lord is not restricted. See how We have favored some of them over others. And the Hereafter is greater in degrees and greater in preference. And God Almighty said: “Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest. And whoever desires the harvest of this world - We give him thereof, but he has not in the Hereafter any share.”

11:17: God Almighty tells us about the state of the believers who are upon the nature of God Almighty upon which He created His servants, which is to acknowledge that there is no god but Him, as God Almighty said: “So direct your face toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the nature of God upon which He has created mankind.” And in the two Sahihs on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Every child is born upon the fitrah, then his parents make him a Jew, a Christian, or a Zoroastrian, just as an animal is born whole. Do you see any among them with their ears cut off?” The hadith. In Sahih Muslim, on the authority of Iyad bin Hammad, on the authority of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said: “God the Most High says: ‘Indeed, I created My servants as monotheists, but the devils came to them and led them astray from their religion, and forbade them what I had permitted them, and commanded them to associate with Me that for which I had not sent down any authority. ’” In Al-Musnad and Al-Sunan, Every newborn is born upon this religion until his tongue expresses it, the hadith. So the believer remains upon this fitrah. His statement, and a witness from Him follows him, means a witness from God comes to him, which is what He revealed to the prophets of the pure, perfect, and honored laws that conclude with the law of Muhammad, may God bless him and grant him peace and them all. For this reason, Ibn Abbas, Mujahid, Ikrimah, Abu Al-Aaliyah, Ad-Dahhak, Ibrahim An-Nakha’i, As-Suddi, and more than one said regarding His statement, and a witness from Him follows him, that he is Gabriel, peace be upon him. And on the authority of Ali, may God be pleased with him, and Al-Hasan and Qatadah, it is Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, and both are close in meaning because both Gabriel and Muhammad, may God’s prayers be upon them, conveyed the message of God Almighty, so Gabriel to Muhammad and Muhammad to the nation, and it was said that it was Ali, and it is weak and no one can prove it, and the first and second are the truth, and that is because the believer has from the innate disposition what testifies to the Sharia in terms of the general and the details taken from the Sharia and the innate disposition confirms it and believes in it, and for this reason God Almighty said: Is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord and a witness from Him recites it? and it is the Qur’an that Gabriel conveyed to the Prophet, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, and the Prophet Muhammad, may God’s prayers and peace be upon him, conveyed it to his nation, then God Almighty said: And before it was the Book of Moses meaning and before the Qur’an was the Book of Moses, which is the Torah as an imam and a mercy meaning God Almighty sent it down to that nation as an imam for them and a role model for them to follow and a mercy from God to them, so whoever believes in it with true faith, that leads him to believe in the Qur’an, and for this reason God Almighty said: Those believe in it then God Almighty said, threatening whoever denies the Qur’an or any part of it: And whoever disbelieves in it from the parties “Then the Fire is his promised destination, meaning whoever disbelieves in the Qur’an from among all the people of the earth, including polytheists, unbelievers, People of the Book, and others from among all the sects of the children of Adam, regardless of their color, shape, or race, to whom the Qur’an has reached, as God Almighty said: To warn you thereby and whomever it reaches. And God Almighty said: Say, ‘O mankind, indeed I am the Messenger of God to you all.’ And God Almighty said: And whoever disbelieves in it from the parties, the Fire is his promised destination. In Sahih Muslim, from the hadith of Shu’bah, from Abu Bishr, from Sa’id ibn Jubayr, from Abu Musa al-Ash’ari, may God be pleased with him, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: By the One in Whose Hand is my soul, no one from this nation, whether Jewish or Christian, hears of me and does not believe in me except that he will enter the Fire. Ayoub al-Sakhtiyani said, from Sa’id ibn Jubayr, who said: I would not hear a hadith from the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, as it is, except that I found its confirmation, or he said its verification, in the Qur’an. Then it reached me that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: No one from this nation, whether Jewish or Christian, hears of me and does not believe in me except that he will enter the Fire. So I began to say, Where is its confirmation in the Book of God? He said: I rarely heard about the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, except that I found confirmation of it in the Qur’an until I found this verse: And whoever disbelieves in it from the parties - the Fire is his promised destination. He said: From all religions. And His saying: “So be not in doubt about it. Indeed, it is the truth from your Lord.” The verse, meaning the Qur’an is the truth from God, there is no doubt or suspicion in it, as God the Almighty said: “Alif, Lam, Meem. The revelation of the Book, about which there is no doubt, is from the Lord of the worlds.” And God the Almighty said: “Alif, Lam, Meem. That is the Book about which there is no doubt.” And His saying: But most people do not believe, is like His saying: And most people are not believers, even if you strive to do so. And God the Almighty said: And if you obey most of those on the earth, they will mislead you from the way of God. And God the Almighty said: And Satan has already proven true about them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of the believers.
11:18: God Almighty shows the state of those who slander Him and their disgrace in the Hereafter in front of all creation, from the angels, messengers, prophets, and all other human beings and jinn, as Imam Ahmad said: He told us, Haz and Affan told us, Hammam told us, Qatada told us, on the authority of Safwan bin Mahraz, who said: I was holding the hand of Ibn Umar when a man came to him and said: How did you hear the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, say about the secret conversation on the Day of Resurrection? He said: I heard him say: “God, the Almighty, brings the believer close, covers him with His cloak, conceals him from the people, and makes him confess his sins and says to him: Do you recognize such and such a sin? Do you recognize such and such a sin? Do you recognize such and such a sin? Until when He makes him confess his sins and he sees in himself that he has perished, He says: I concealed them from you in this world, and I forgive them today.” Then he is given the book of his good deeds. As for the disbelievers and hypocrites, He says: “These are the witnesses who lied about their Lord. Unquestionably, the curse of God is upon the wrongdoers.” The verse was narrated by Al-Bukhari and Muslim in the two Sahihs from the hadith of Qatadah with it. His statement: Those who hinder [people] from the path of God and seek to make it crooked means they prevent people from following the truth and taking the path of guidance that leads to God, the Almighty, and they avoid Paradise. And seek to make it crooked means they want their path to be crooked and not straight. And in the Hereafter they are disbelievers meaning they deny it and reject its occurrence and existence. Those were not able to escape on earth, and they had no power to do so. “There are no protectors besides God.” That is, they were under His subjugation and dominance and in His grasp and authority, and He is able to take revenge on them in this world before the Hereafter. He only delays them for a Day when eyes will stare in horror. In the two Sahihs: Indeed, God gives respite to the wrongdoer until, when He seizes him, He does not let him escape. That is why God the Almighty said: He will double their punishment 1:18, meaning He will double their punishment. That is because God the Almighty gave them hearing, sight, and hearts, but their hearing, sight, and hearts did not avail them, rather they were deaf to hearing the truth and blind to following it, as God the Almighty informed us about them when they entered the Fire, as He said: And they said, ‘If only we had listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the companions of the Blaze.’ 1:18, and God the Almighty said: Those who disbelieved and averted from the way of God - We will increase for them a punishment over the punishment. 1:18, and that is why they are punished for every command they abandoned and every prohibition they committed. That is why the most correct of the sayings is that they are charged with the branches of the laws, their commands and prohibitions with respect to the Hereafter. His statement: Those are the ones who have lost their souls, and what they used to invent has gone astray from them, meaning they have lost their souls because they have entered a blazing Fire, so they are punished in it and its punishment will not abate for the blink of an eye, as God the Almighty said: Every time it subsides, We increase for them a punishment over the punishment. 1:18, and that is why they are punished for every command they abandoned and every prohibition they committed. That is why the most correct of the sayings is that they are charged with the branches of the laws, their commands and prohibitions with respect to the Hereafter. His statement: Those are the ones who have lost their souls, and what they used to invent has gone astray from them, meaning they have lost their souls because they have entered a blazing Fire, so they are punished in it and its punishment will not abate for them for the blink of an eye, as God the Almighty said: Every time it subsides, We increase for them a punishment over the punishment. ( A Blaze “And what they used to invent” other than God of rivals and idols was lost from them. So you did not find anything from them, but rather it harmed them completely, as God Almighty said: And when the people are gathered together, they will be enemies to them and will be disbelievers in their worship. God the Almighty said: “And they have taken other gods besides God that they might be a source of strength for them. No! They will disbelieve in their worship and will be opponents to them.” And Abraham said to his al-Nas 114:“You have only taken other than God idols out of affection among yourselves in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection some of you will disbelieve in others and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.” And His statement: When those who followed disown those who followed them and they see the punishment, and their ties are severed. And other verses indicating their loss and destruction. For this reason He said: There is no doubt that in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers. God the Almighty informs about their fate, that they are the greatest losers in the Hereafter, because they exchanged the levels for the degrees, and exchanged the bliss of Paradise for boiling water, and the drinking of sealed nectar for poisonous water and boiling water and the shade of hot water, and the wide-eyed houris for food of pure water, and the high palaces for the abyss, and the closeness of the Most Merciful and seeing Him for the wrath of the Judge and His punishment. So there is no doubt that in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.

11:23: When God the Almighty mentioned the state of the wretched, He followed it with mentioning the happy ones, who are those who believed and did righteous deeds, so their hearts believed and their limbs performed righteous deeds in word and deed, such as performing acts of obedience and abandoning evil. With this, they inherited the Gardens, which contain high rooms, lined couches, low-hanging fruits, high and beautiful beauties, various fruits, desirable foods and delicious drinks, and looking at the Creator of the earth and the heavens. They are immortal in that, they do not die, nor do they grow old, nor do they get sick, nor do they sleep, nor do they defecate, nor do they spit, nor do they blow their noses. It is nothing but a musk odor that they sweat. Then God the Almighty gave an example of the disbelievers and the believers, saying: The example of the two groups, meaning those whom He described first as wretched and the believers as happy. Those are like the blind and deaf, and these are like the seeing and hearing. The disbeliever is blind to the face of truth in this world and the hereafter, he is not guided to good nor… He knows it, but he is deaf to hearing arguments and does not hear what benefits him. If God had known any good in them, He would have made them hear. As for the believer, he is intelligent, clever, perceptive of the truth, distinguishing between it and falsehood, so he follows good and abandons evil. He hears the argument and distinguishes between it and doubt, so falsehood does not prevail over him. Are these equal? Do you not remember? Do you not consider and differentiate between these and those, as He said in the other verse: The companions of the Fire are not equal to the companions of Paradise? The companions of Paradise - they are the successful ones. And as He said: “And the blind and the seeing are not alike, nor are darkness and light, nor shade and heat. Nor are the living and the dead. Indeed, God hears whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves. You are only a warner. Indeed, We have sent you, [O Muhammad], with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And there was no nation but that a warner had passed among them.”

11:25: God Almighty tells us about Noah, peace be upon him, who was the first Messenger sent by God to the people of the earth from the polytheists who worshipped idols. He said to his people, Indeed, I am to you a clear warner, meaning, a clear warning to you of God’s punishment if you worship other than God. That is why He said, That you worship none but God. And His statement, Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful Day, meaning, if you continue as you are, God will punish you with a painful, hurtful, and difficult punishment in the Hereafter. Then the eminent ones among his people who disbelieved said, and the eminent ones are the leaders and notables among the disbelievers among them, We see you only as a human being like ourselves, meaning, you are not a king, but you are a human being. So how could revelation be sent to you without us? Then we see that only the most lowly of us follow you, like the merchants, the weavers, and their likes. Neither the nobles nor the leaders among us followed you. Then those who followed you were not out of deliberation, thought, or consideration, but rather as soon as you called them, they responded to you and followed you. That is why they said, And “We see that you are followed by none but the most worthless among us, at first sight, that is, at the first sight of the first sight, and we see that you have no superiority over us, they say, We see that you have no superiority over us in character, nor in creation, nor in provision, nor in condition, since you have entered this religion of yours, “but we think you are liars,” that is, in what you claim for yourself of righteousness, goodness, worship, and happiness in the Hereafter when you reach it. This is the objection of the disbelievers to Noah, peace be upon him, and his followers, and it is evidence of their ignorance, lack of knowledge, and intellect, for it is not a disgrace to the truth that the one who follows it is worthless, for the truth in itself is correct, whether the nobles or the lowly follow it. Rather, the truth about which there is no doubt is that the followers of the truth are the nobles, even if they are poor, and those who reject it are the lowly, even if they are rich. Then the reality is that the truth is often followed by the weak among the people, and the majority of the nobles and the great oppose it, as God Almighty said: And likewise, We did not send before you a warner to any city except that its affluent ones said, ‘Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we will indeed follow in their footsteps.’ When Heraclius, the king of the Romans, asked Abu Sufyan Sakhr ibn Harb about the characteristics of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said to him, among other things: The nobles of the people followed him, or the weak among them. He said: Rather, the weak among them. Heraclius said: They are the followers of the Messengers, and their saying the first opinion is not a blame or a defect, because when the truth is clear, there is no room for opinion or thought, rather the truth must be followed, and this is the case for every intelligent and clever person, rather, no one thinks here except the stupid or the feeble-minded, and the Messengers, may God bless them and grant them peace, came with a clear and obvious command. It was reported in the hadith that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: I did not call anyone to Islam except that he had a stumble, except for Abu Bakr, for he did not falter. That is, he did not hesitate or hesitate because he saw a clear, great, and obvious matter, so he hastened to it and rushed to it. And his saying: And we do not see that you have any superiority over us they do not see that because they are blind to the truth, they do not hear or see, rather they are in their doubt, hesitating in the darkness of ignorance, wandering blindly, and they are the liars, the liars, the least, the most despicable, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.

And his saying: And we do not see that you have any superiority over us they do not see that because they are blind to the truth, they do not hear or see, rather they are in their doubt, hesitating in the darkness of ignorance, wandering blindly, and they are the liars, the liars, the least, the most despicable, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
11:27: God Almighty tells us about Noah, peace be upon him, who was the first Messenger sent by God to the people of the earth from the polytheists who worshipped idols. He said to his people, Indeed, I am to you a clear warner, meaning, a clear warning to you of God’s punishment if you worship other than God. That is why He said, That you worship none but God. And His statement, Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a painful Day, meaning, if you continue as you are, God will punish you with a painful, hurtful, and difficult punishment in the Hereafter. Then the eminent ones among his people who disbelieved said, and the eminent ones are the leaders and notables among the disbelievers among them, We see you only as a human being like ourselves, meaning, you are not a king, but you are a human being. So how could revelation be sent to you without us? Then we see that only the most lowly of us follow you, like the merchants, the weavers, and their likes. Neither the nobles nor the leaders among us followed you. Then those who followed you were not out of deliberation, thought, or consideration, but rather as soon as you called them, they responded to you and followed you. That is why they said, And “We see that you are followed by none but the most worthless among us, at first sight, that is, at the first sight of the first sight, and we see that you have no superiority over us, they say, We see that you have no superiority over us in character, nor in creation, nor in provision, nor in condition, since you have entered this religion of yours, “but we think you are liars,” that is, in what you claim for yourself of righteousness, goodness, worship, and happiness in the Hereafter when you reach it. This is the objection of the disbelievers to Noah, peace be upon him, and his followers, and it is evidence of their ignorance, lack of knowledge, and intellect, for it is not a disgrace to the truth that the one who follows it is worthless, for the truth in itself is correct, whether the nobles or the lowly follow it. Rather, the truth about which there is no doubt is that the followers of the truth are the nobles, even if they are poor, and those who reject it are the lowly, even if they are rich. Then the reality is that the truth is often followed by the weak among the people, and the majority of the nobles and the great oppose it, as God Almighty said: And likewise, We did not send before you a warner to any city except that its affluent ones said, ‘Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we will indeed follow in their footsteps.’ When Heraclius, the king of the Romans, asked Abu Sufyan Sakhr ibn Harb about the characteristics of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, he said to him, among other things: The nobles of the people followed him, or the weak among them. He said: Rather, the weak among them. Heraclius said: They are the followers of the Messengers, and their saying the first opinion is not a blame or a defect, because when the truth is clear, there is no room for opinion or thought, rather the truth must be followed, and this is the case for every intelligent and clever person, rather, no one thinks here except the stupid or the feeble-minded, and the Messengers, may God bless them and grant them peace, came with a clear and obvious command. 11:28: God Almighty says, informing us of what Noah responded to his people with in this regard: Have you considered, if I am on clear evidence from my Lord? That is, on certainty, a clear command, and a true prophecy, which is the great mercy from God to him and to them, but it is hidden from you, that is, it was concealed from you, so you were not guided to it, nor did you know its value, but rather you hastened to deny it and reject it. Should We force it upon you? That is, should We anger you by accepting it while you are averse to it?
11:29: He says to his people, "I do not ask you for money for my advice to you: a fee that I take from you. I only seek the reward from God Almighty. "And I will not drive away those who believe." It is as if they asked him to drive away the believers out of modesty and respect for them to sit with them, just as their peers asked the Seal of the Messengers, may God bless him and grant him peace, to drive away a group of weak people and sit with them in a special session. So God Almighty revealed: "And do not drive away those who call upon their Lord morning and evening." The verse. And God Almighty said: "And thus We have tried some of them by others that they may say, Are these among us whom God has bestowed favor upon? Is not God most knowing of the grateful? The verses.

11:31: He tells them that he is a messenger from God calling to the worship of God alone, with no partner for Him, with God’s permission for that, and he does not ask them for a reward for that, but rather he calls whoever he meets, noble or lowly, and whoever responds to him is saved. He tells them that he has no power to dispose of God’s treasures and he does not know of the unseen except what God has informed him of, and he is not an angel from the angels, but rather he is a human being sent and supported by miracles. I do not say about those whom you belittle and despise that they have no reward from God for their deeds. God knows best what is in their souls. If they were believers inwardly, as is apparent from their state, then they will have a good reward. If a human being were to cut them off after they had believed, he would be unjust, saying what he has no knowledge of.
11:32: God Almighty says, informing us about the people of Noah’s hastening of God’s vengeance, punishment, and anger, and the affliction is entrusted to logic. They said, O Noah, you have disputed with us and prolonged your dispute with us. That is, you have argued with us and prolonged that, and we do not follow you. Bring to us what you threaten us. That is, of punishment and torment. Invoke upon us whatever you wish, so let what you invoke come to us, if you should be of the truthful. He said, "Only God will bring it upon you, if He wills. And you will not escape." That is, the One Who will punish you and hasten it for you is God, for Whom nothing is impossible. And my advice will not benefit you, if I intended to advise you, if God wants to mislead you. That is, what would my informing you, warning you, and advising you do to you, if God wants to mislead you? That is, mislead you and destroy you. He is your Lord, and to Him you will be returned. That is, He is the Master of all affairs, the Disposer of affairs, the Just Ruler Who does not transgress. To Him belongs creation and to Him belongs the command. He is the Originator, the Restorer, the Owner of this world and the Hereafter.

11:35: This is an interjection in the middle of this story, confirming it. Deciding on it, God Almighty says to Muhammad: Or do these disbelieving deniers say, He invented this and fabricated it of his own accord? Say, If I have invented it, then upon me is my crime, meaning, then the sin of that is upon me, and I am innocent of what you commit, meaning, that was not fabricated or invented, because I know what punishment God has for those who lie about Him.
11:36: God Almighty tells us that He revealed to Noah when his people hastened God's punishment and torment upon them, so Noah made a supplication against them, which God Almighty said, informing us about, that he said: My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers a single dwelling. "So he called upon his Lord, 'Indeed, I am overcome, so aid.' At that time God revealed to him, None of your people will believe except those who have already believed." So do not grieve over them and do not worry about their matter. "And construct the ark, meaning the ship, under Our eyes, meaning in Our sight, and with Our revelation," meaning Our teaching you what to make. "And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned." Some of the predecessors said: God Almighty commanded him to plant the wood, cut it, and dry it, and that was in one hundred years, and he carved it in another one hundred years. It was also said in forty years, and God knows best. Muhammad bin Ishaq mentioned about the Torah: that God commanded him to make it from teak wood and to make its length eighty cubits and its width fifty cubits and to coat its interior and exterior with pitch and to make it have a scalloped crown that would split the water. Qatada said that its length was three hundred cubits and its width fifty. According to Al-Hasan, its length was six hundred cubits and its width three hundred. According to him and Ibn Abbas, its length was one thousand two hundred cubits and its width six hundred. It was said that its length was one thousand cubits and its width one hundred cubits. God knows best. They all said that its height in the sky was thirty cubits, with three layers, each layer ten cubits. The lower one was for the beasts and wild animals, the middle one was for humans, and the upper one was for the birds. Its door was across its width and it had a covering over it. Imam Abu Jaafar bin Jarir mentioned a strange trace from the hadith of Ali bin Zaid bin Jadaan from Yusuf bin Mahran from Abdullah bin Abbas that he said: The disciples said to Jesus, son of Maryam 19:If you would send us a man who witnessed the ship, then tell us about it. He said: So he set off with them until he reached a mound of dirt. He took a handful of that dirt in his hand and said: Do you know what this is? They said: God and His Messenger know best. He said: This is the heel of Ham bin Noah. He said: So he struck the mound with his staff and said: Get up by God’s permission. And behold, he was standing, shaking the dirt off his head, and his hair had turned grey. Jesus, peace be upon him, said to him: Is this how you perished? He said: No. Rather, I died when I was young, but I thought that it was the Hour, and that is why I turned grey. He said: Tell us about Noah’s ship? He said: Its length was one thousand and two hundred cubits and its width was six hundred cubits. It had three layers: one layer had animals and wild beasts, one layer had humans, and one layer had birds. When the animals’ dung became abundant, God Almighty inspired Noah, peace be upon him, to poke the elephant’s tail. He poke it, and a male and female pig fell from it, and they headed toward the dung. When the mouse fell into the belly of the ship, gnawing at it and its ropes, God inspired him to strike between the lion’s eyes. He struck, and a male and female cat came out of its nostrils, and they headed toward the mouse. Jesus, peace be upon him, said to him: How did Noah know that the land had been flooded? He said: He sent a crow to bring him the report, and it found a carcass and landed on it. It cursed it with fear, and that is why it does not frequent houses. He said: Then he sent the dove and it brought olive leaves in its beak and clay in its feet, so he knew that the country had been flooded. He said: So he put the greenery around its neck around its neck and prayed that it would be at peace and secure, and thus it would be at peace with the people. He said: So we said, O Messenger of God, should we not take him to our families so that he may sit with us and talk to us? He said: How can someone who has no provision follow you? He said: So he said to him: Return by God’s permission, so he returned to dust. And His statement: And he built the ark, and every time a group of his people passed by him, they ridiculed him meaning they mocked him and denied what he threatened them with of drowning. “He said: If you ridicule us, then we will ridicule you” is a severe threat and a definite warning. Whoever is visited by a punishment that will disgrace him meaning that it will humiliate him in this world and a lasting punishment will descend upon him meaning, permanent and continuous forever.

11:40: This is a promise from God Almighty to Noah, peace be upon him, if God’s command came of continuous rain and the continuous flood that does not cease or cease, but rather it is as God Almighty said: “So We opened the gates of heaven with pouring water. And We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, and the waters met by a command already ordained. And We carried him on planks and nails. Flowing under Our eyes, a reward for him who had disbelieved.” As for his saying, and the oven overflowed, it is narrated from Ibn Abbas that the oven was the face of the earth, meaning the earth became springs that overflowed until the water overflowed from the ovens, which are the place of the fire, and it became overflowing with water. This is the saying of the majority of the predecessors and the scholars of the successors. And from Ali ibn Abi Talib, may God be pleased with him, the oven is the break of dawn and the illumination of dawn, which is its light and radiance, and the first is more apparent. Mujahid and Al-Sha’bi said: This oven was in Kufa. And from Ibn Abbas, it was a spring in India. And from Qatada, it was a spring in Al-Jazirah called the Spring of the Rose. These are strange sayings. Then God commanded Noah, peace be upon him, to carry with him in the ship two of every kind of living creatures. It was said: And other plants, two males and one female. It was said that the first bird to be introduced was the pearl and the last animal to be introduced was the donkey. Satan clung to its tail and tried to get up, but Satan weighed him down while he was clinging to its tail. So Noah, peace be upon him, said to it: What is wrong with you? Come in. But he got up and was not able to. So he said: Come in, even if Satan is with you. So they entered the ship. Some of the predecessors mentioned that they were not able to carry the lion with them until a fever was cast upon it. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us: Abdullah bin Saleh, the scribe of Al-Layth, told us: Al-Layth told me: Hisham bin Saad told me, on the authority of Zaid bin Aslam, on the authority of his father, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “When Noah carried two of each kind on the ship, his companions said: How can the livestock be at peace when there is a lion with them? So God sent a fever upon him, and it was the first fever to descend upon the earth. Then they complained about the mouse, and they said: The mouse spoils our food and our provisions. So God inspired the lion, and he sneezed, and the cat came out of him, and the mouse hid from it.” And His statement, And your family, except for those against whom the word has already passed, meaning, take your family into it, and they are his family and relatives, except for those against whom the word has already passed from among them, who did not believe in God, and among them was his son Yam, who isolated himself by himself, and the wife of Noah, who was a disbeliever in God and His Messenger. And His statement, And those who believed, meaning from your people, and none believed with him except a few, meaning a small number, despite the long period of time and residence among them, a thousand years minus fifty years. According to Ibn Abbas, they were eighty souls, including their women. According to Ka’b al-Ahbar, they were seventy-two souls. It was said that they were ten. It was said that Noah and his three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth, and his four daughters-in-law, were the women of these three and the wife of Yam. It was said that Noah’s wife was with them in the ship, and this is questionable. Rather, it appears that she perished because she followed the religion of her people, so what happened to them happened to her, just as what happened to the wife of Lot happened to her people. And God knows best and is most wise.

The Sunnah came with urging and encouraging this, as will come in Surat Az-Zukhruf, God willing, and it is trustworthy. 11:44: God Almighty tells us that when He drowned all the people of the earth except the people of the ship, He ordered the earth to swallow the water that had sprung from it and gathered on it, and He ordered the sky to stop raining. And the water subsided, meaning it began to decrease. And the matter was accomplished, meaning it was finished with all the people of the earth who disbelieved in God. No homes remained of them. And the ship came to rest with those in it on Al-Judi. Mujahid said: It is a mountain on the island. The mountains became high on that day from the drowning and became tall, but it was humble before God Almighty and did not sink. And the ship of Noah, peace be upon him, came to rest on it. Qatada said: It came to rest on it for a month until they disembarked from it. Qatada said: God left the ship of Noah, peace be upon him, on Al-Judi in the land of the island as a lesson and a sign until the first of this nation saw it. How many ships were there after it that perished and turned to ashes. Ad-Dahhak said: Al-Judi is a mountain in Mosul. Some of them said: It is At-Tur. Ibn Abi Hatim said: My father told us, Amr bin Rafi’ told us, Muhammad bin Ubaid told us, on the authority of Tobah bin Salim, who said: I saw Zur bin Hubaish praying in the corner when he entered from the gates of Kinda on your right, so I asked him: Do you pray here a lot on Friday? He said: It has reached me that Noah’s Ark came to rest from here. Alba’ bin Ahmar said on the authority of Ikrimah on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: There were eighty men with Noah on the ship, along with their families, and they were in it for one hundred and fifty days. God directed the ship to Mecca, so it circled the House for forty days, then God directed it to Judi, so it settled on it. Noah sent the raven to bring him report of the land, so it went and landed on the carcasses, but it was slow to reach him, so he sent the dove, which brought him olive leaves and smeared its feet with mud. Noah, peace be upon him, knew that the water had dried up, so he descended to the bottom of Judi and built a village, and he named it Thaman. One day, their tongues were confused in eighty languages, one of which was the Arabic language, so some of them did not understand the speech of others, so Noah, peace be upon him, interpreted for them. Kaab al-Ahbar said: The ship sailed between the east and the west before it came to rest on al-Judi. Qatada and others said: They embarked on the tenth of Rajab and traveled for one hundred and fifty days and came to rest on al-Judi for a month. They left the ship on the day of Ashura of Muharram. Something similar to this was reported in a hadith with a chain of transmission traceable to the Prophet, narrated by Ibn Jarir, and that they fasted that day. And God knows best. Imam Ahmad said: Abu Ja`far told us: `Abd al-Samad ibn Habib al-Azdi told us, on the authority of his father Habib ibn `Abdullah, on the authority of Shibl, on the authority of Abu Hurayrah, who said: The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, passed by some Jews who were fasting on the day of `Ashura’ and said: What is this fasting? They said: “This is the day on which God saved Moses and the Children of Israel from drowning, and Pharaoh drowned on it. This is the day on which the ship came to rest on Mount Judi, and Noah and Moses, peace be upon them, fasted in gratitude to God Almighty.” The Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: I am more deserving of Moses and more deserving of fasting on this day. So he fasted and said to his companions: Whoever among you has fasted, let him complete his fast, and whoever has eaten food from his family, let him complete the rest of the day. This is a strange hadith from this aspect, and some of it is corroborated in Sahih. His saying: “And it was said: ‘Away with the wrongdoing people,’” means destruction and loss for them and distance from the mercy of God, for they were all destroyed, and there was no remnant of them. Imam Abu Ja`far ibn Jarir and the scholar Abu Muhammad ibn Abi Hatim narrated in their interpretations from the hadith of Musa ibn Ya`qub al-Zama`i from Qayyid, the freed slave of `Ubayd God ibn Abi Rafi` that Ibrahim ibn `Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Rabi`ah informed him that `Aisha, the wife of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, informed him that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: If God had mercy on anyone from the people of Noah, He would have had mercy on the mother of the child. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Noah, peace be upon him, stayed among his people for a thousand years minus fifty years, meaning that he planted trees for a hundred years, and they grew large and went in every direction, then he cut them down and made them into a ship, and they would pass by him and mock him and say, ‘You are making a ship on land, so how can it sail? ’ He said, ‘You will soon know. ’ So when it was finished and the water sprang forth and was in the paths, the mother of the child feared for him, and she loved him very much, so she went out to the mountain until she reached a third of it, and when the water reached her, she rose until she reached two-thirds of it, and when the water reached her, she went out with him until she was level on the mountain, and when the water reached her neck, she lifted him up with her hands and they drowned. So if God had mercy on anyone from them, He would have had mercy on the mother of the child.” A strange hadith from this aspect. The story of this boy and his mother was narrated on the authority of Ka’b al-Ahbar and Mujahid ibn Jubayr in a similar manner.
11:45: This is a question of inquiry and revelation from Noah, peace be upon him, about the condition of his son who drowned. He said, ‘My Lord, indeed my son is of my family.’ That is, You promised me the salvation of my family, and Your promise is the truth that never fails. How could he drown, when You are the most just of judges? He said, ‘O Noah, indeed he is not of your family.’ That is, those whom I promised to save, because I only promised you the salvation of those of your family who believed. That is why He said, And your family, except for those of them against whom the word has already passed. So this son was among those against whom the word of drowning had already passed, because of his disbelief and opposition to his father, the Prophet of God, Noah, peace be upon him. More than one of the imams has stated that whoever interpreted this to mean that he was not his son, but rather the son of fornication was mistaken. The statement that he was not his son, but rather the son of his wife, is narrated from Mujahid, Al-Hasan, Ubayd ibn Umair, Abu Ja`far Al-Baqir, and Ibn Jarir. Some of them used as evidence his statement, It is an unrighteous deed, and his statement, So they betrayed them. Among those who said this, Al-Hasan Al-Basri used as evidence these two. The two verses, and some of them say his wife’s son. This may mean that he meant what Al-Hasan meant, or he meant that it was attributed to him metaphorically because he was his foster son. And God knows best. Ibn Abbas and more than one of the Salaf said: No Prophet’s wife ever committed adultery. He said: And his saying: He is not of your family means those whose salvation you were promised. And Ibn Abbas’s saying in this is the truth that cannot be avoided, for God, the Exalted, is too jealous to allow a Prophet’s wife to commit fornication. For this reason God became angry with those who accused the Mother of the Believers, Aisha, the daughter of As-Siddiq, the wife of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and denounced the believers who spoke of this and spread it. For this reason God, the Exalted, said: “Indeed, those who came with the slander are a group among you. Do not think it is evil for you; rather, it is good for you. To each person among them is what he has earned of sin, and he among them who took upon himself the greater part thereof will have a great punishment. * Why did not, when you heard it, the believing men and believing women think well of one another and say, “This is a manifest slander?” * Why did they not produce four witnesses for it? But since they did not produce witnesses, then those are the liars in the sight of God. * And were it not for God’s favor upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, a great punishment would have afflicted you for what you uttered therein, * When you were receiving it with your tongues and saying with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge.” And you think it is insignificant, but it is grave in the sight of God.” Abdul Razzaq said: Muammar told us, on the authority of Qatada and others, on the authority of Ikrimah, on the authority of Ibn Abbas, who said: He is his son, except that he differed with him in action and intention. Ikrimah said in some letters that he did an unrighteous deed, and betrayal is not done in a way that is not appropriate. It was mentioned in the hadith that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, recited it thus, so Imam Ahmad said: Yazid bin Harun told us, Hammad bin Salamah told us, on the authority of Thabit, on the authority of Shahr bin Hawshab, on the authority of Asma bint Yazid, who said: I heard the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, recite: Indeed, it is an unrighteous deed. And I heard him say: “O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of God. Indeed, God forgives all sins.” And He does not care. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Most Merciful. Ahmad also said: Waki’ told us, Harun al-Nahwi told us, on the authority of Thabit al-Banani, on the authority of Shahr bin Hawshab, on the authority of Umm Salamah, that the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, recited it: Indeed, it is an unrighteous deed. Ahmad also repeated it in his Musnad. Umm Salamah is the Mother of the Believers, and it appears, and God knows best, that she is Asma bint Yazid, for she is also called by that name. Abdul Razzaq also said: Al-Thawri informed us on the authority of Ibn Uyaynah on the authority of Musa bin Abi Aishah on the authority of Sulayman bin Qubbah who said: I heard Ibn Abbas asked while he was next to the Kaaba about the statement of God: And they both betrayed them. He said: It was not for adultery, but this one was telling people that he was crazy, and this one was pointing out the guests. Then he recited: Indeed, it is an unrighteous deed. Ibn Uyaynah said: Ammar Al-Dahni informed me that he asked Saeed bin Jubair about that and he said: He was the son of Noah. God does not lie. God the Almighty said: And Noah called to his son. Some scholars said: No prophet’s wife ever committed adultery. This was also narrated on the authority of Mujahid, Ikrimah, Ad-Dahhak, Maymun bin Mihran, and Thabit bin Al-Hajjaj. This is the choice of Abu Ja`far bin Jarir and it is the correct one, about which there is no doubt.
